scope: Full standalone PostgreSQL provider-declared Realtime composite attribute signatures and extension base type; array dependency verification; separate from array record receipt and Run189 enum/sequence.

queries.standalone_types: SELECT n.nspname schema,t.typname name,t.typtype type_kind,t.typcategory category,COALESCE(c.relkind::text,'-') underlying_relation,pg_get_userbyid(t.typowner) owner,t.typacl::text acl,format_type(t.oid,NULL) qualified_type,format_type(t.typbasetype,NULL) base_type,t.typinput::regproc::text input_proc,t.typoutput::regproc::text output_proc,t.typreceive::regproc::text receive_proc,t.typsend::regproc::text send_proc,t.typlen,t.typbyval,t.typalign,t.typstorage,t.typnotnull,has_type_privilege('anon',t.oid,'USAGE') anon_usage,has_schema_privilege('anon',n.oid,'USAGE') anon_schema_usage,(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('n',a.attname,'type',format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),'notnull',a.attnotnull,'collation',CASE WHEN a.attcollation=0 THEN NULL ELSE a.attcollation::regcollation::text END) ORDER BY a.attnum) FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid=c.oid AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped) attrs,md5(row_to_json(t)::text) catalog_row_md5 FROM pg_type t JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.typnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.typrelid WHERE (n.nspname='realtime' AND t.typtype='c' AND c.relkind='c') OR (n.nspname='extensions' AND t.typtype='b' AND t.typcategory='U') ORDER BY 1,2
queries.array_dependencies: WITH a AS (SELECT t.oid, n.nspname schema,t.typname name, e.typarray=t.oid AS element_backref_ok, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_depend d WHERE d.classid='pg_type'::regclass AND d.objid=t.oid AND d.refclassid='pg_type'::regclass AND d.refobjid=e.oid AND d.deptype IN ('i','a')) AS auto_dependency_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_depend d WHERE d.refclassid='pg_type'::regclass AND d.refobjid=t.oid AND d.deptype='n') AS normal_dependents,(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.prorettype=t.oid OR t.oid=ANY(p.proargtypes) OR t.oid=ANY(p.proallargtypes)) AS referenced_in_routine_signatures FROM pg_type t JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.typnamespace JOIN pg_type e ON e.oid=t.typelem WHERE t.typtype='b' AND t.typcategory='A' AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema') SELECT jsonb_build_object('count',(SELECT count(*) FROM a),'unmatched_backrefs',(SELECT count(*) FROM a WHERE NOT element_backref_ok),'missing_automatic_deps',(SELECT count(*) FROM a WHERE auto_dependency_count=0),'normal_dependents_total',(SELECT sum(normal_dependents) FROM a),'with_routine_signatures',(SELECT count(*) FROM a WHERE referenced_in_routine_signatures>0),'uses',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',schema,'name',name,'normal_dependents',normal_dependents,'routine_signatures',referenced_in_routine_signatures,'auto_deps',auto_dependency_count) ORDER BY schema,name) FROM a WHERE normal_dependents>0 OR referenced_in_routine_signatures>0 OR auto_dependency_count=0 OR NOT element_backref_ok)) AS audit
queries.usage_signatures: WITH arr AS (SELECT t.oid,t.typname,n.nspname FROM pg_type t JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.typnamespace WHERE n.nspname='realtime' AND t.typname IN ('_user_defined_filter','_wal_column')), sig AS (SELECT a.nspname schema,a.typname type_name,p.oid,p.proname function_name, pn.nspname function_schema,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) arguments,pg_get_function_result(p.oid) result_type,p.prosecdef security_definer FROM arr a JOIN pg_proc p ON (p.prorettype=a.oid OR a.oid=ANY(p.proargtypes) OR a.oid=ANY(p.proallargtypes)) JOIN pg_namespace pn ON pn.oid=p.pronamespace), cols AS (SELECT a.nspname schema,a.typname type_name,cr.relname relation,ns.nspname relation_schema,at.attname col_name,cr.relrowsecurity rls FROM arr a JOIN pg_attribute at ON at.atttypid=a.oid AND at.attnum>0 AND NOT at.attisdropped JOIN pg_class cr ON cr.oid=at.attrelid JOIN pg_namespace ns ON ns.oid=cr.relnamespace) SELECT jsonb_build_object('signatures',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(sig) ORDER BY type_name,function_schema,function_name) FROM sig),'columns',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(cols) ORDER BY type_name,relation,col_name) FROM cols),'pgtrgm',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',e.extname,'version',e.extversion,'schema',n.nspname)) FROM pg_extension e JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=e.extnamespace WHERE e.extname='pg_trgm')) AS evidence

signatures.arguments: prepared_statement_name text, entity regclass, columns realtime.wal_column[]

direct_semantic_assessment: realtime.user_defined_filter is typed filter specification: column_name text, op equality_op, value text, negate boolean; its array is stored in realtime.subscription.filters and inherited partition relation.
realtime.wal_column typed WAL row metadata: name, type_name, type_oid, JSON value, primary-key and selectability markers; its array is used in prepared statement builder and filter evaluator.
realtime.wal_rls carries WAL JSON, RLS enabled boolean, subscription UUID array and errors text array; no source-backed justification to remove.
extensions.gtrgm is the pg_trgm v1.6 index access method support base type. Input/output and plain storage differ intentionally from arrays/composites.
All 106 array type backrefs and automatic type-element dependencies intact; exactly 2 arrays have 5 normal dependents and 3 routine signatures. No direct production data used.
